messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.40
parts:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.40) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

There are a few minor changes plus a new function plot_ci() for plotting a set of confidence intervals, such as for the QTL effects at a fixed QTL position.

Karl Broman
